prompt: Using the attached images ONLY as a style reference (rendering, materials, lighting, palette, composition, background treatment) — do not copy their objects — create a new card illustration of a small white lunar rover with four huge ribbed wheels, blue seats, a tall blue sensor mast and a rear sample basket in its real environment: sunlit lunar plain with pale dust, rounded base domes and distant soft craters; three-quarter view slightly from above; the object is the clear central hero and fills about 70-80% of the frame, tall or wide objects may be cropped by the frame edge, the environment is recognizable but simplified: a few large shapes of the landscape and sky with fluffy clouds, only a little secondary detail, softly blurred, bright daylight, no characters. Style: stylized 3D casual mobile game collectible card art, animated-movie look, soft rounded chunky shapes, slightly exaggerated proportions, no outlines, stylized material textures with medium detail, soft diffuse warm lighting, glossy highlights, soft contact shadow, the object is the most saturated element, background slightly softer, single object centered, fills about 75% of the width, top 12% of the frame kept clear, toy-like simplified forms with smooth surfaces, thick chunky parts instead of thin lattices or wires, no fine fibers or strands, no small scattered details. Vertical 9:10 composition. No text, letters, numbers, logos, frames, borders, rounded corners, card UI, stars, outlines, photorealism, dark gloomy tones, clutter, people, animals. Context of this card set: One day of a lunar cartographer at a friendly Moon base, from suiting up in the morning to an evening rover check across the crater yard.. Let this context shape only the surface, environment and background mood; show no people, no animals and no other objects from that day.

candidates.comment: Strong toy-like Township style and very readable rover; environment works, but background is blue rather than lilac and the tall mast intrudes into the top safe area.
Clear chunky lunar rover with correct big wheels, blue seats, mast and rear basket; good category 4 hero framing, but the background is not lilac and the mast is too close to the top.

judge.fix: Use a clean bright lilac sky/background and leave the top 12% empty above the sensor mast.
